titulo: Qualcomm: $7.8 billion in buybacks, about 520 jobs layoff notices filed. Here is the math.
descripcion:
Qualcomm, Oct 20, 2026 (CEO memo, as quoted by Reuters): "We must have the right people in the right roles"
Qualcomm's CEO, Cristiano Amon, set out the cuts in an internal memo, Reuters reports. This week it filed California layoff notices covering 520 jobs, the San Diego Union-Tribune reports. The notices cover California only.

Last fiscal year: $7.8 billion in buybacks, FY 2026, company-wide. $7.817 billion spent buying back its own shares, including excise taxes paid, in fiscal 2026 (year ended Sept. 27, 2026): Form 10-K, company-wide.
The math: $7.8 billion in buybacks, FY 2026, company-wide ÷ about 520 jobs (Union-Tribune) = $15 million in buybacks per California layoff job. The result is approximate. The jobs count is approximate, per Union-Tribune.
The facts: $7.8 billion in buybacks, FY 2026, company-wide (SEC EDGAR · Qualcomm, Nov 4, 2026). about 520 jobs layoff notices filed (Union-Tribune via The Star, Nov 18, 2026). The $7.8 billion is fiscal 2026 buybacks, the year ended Sept. 27, 2026. The 520 is California layoff notices filed in November 2026, which fall in fiscal 2027. Both are 2026 on the calendar, but they are different fiscal years.

Right people in the right roles. Here is the buyback column. (Our take.)
